text:
Maya Chen: quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's latency storm. TL;DR — recurring KV cache eviction during long-running sessions + large batched requests caused tail latency spikes. We need concrete evals, regression coverage, and a repeatable chaos drill.

Jordan Alvarez: +1. Thinking 3 parallel tracks: 1) prompt/regression suites (golden outputs), 2) scaled load tests (5x typical qps, varied seq_len), 3) targeted chaos drills (force KV eviction, simulate GPU OOM, network partitions).

Sam Patel: I can own the prompt/regression set. I'll pull ~100 failing sessions from S3 logs and categorize by failure mode. Goal: initial set + CI integration in 10 business days.

Lee Nguyen: I'll add a synthetic load job to perf-ci and include seq_len paramization. Need a small infra tweak to pin sequence_length=2048 for a subset of runners. ETA: one week to get baseline, two for 5x test ramp.

Kai Ito: I'll draft the chaos drill runbook and coordinate with oncall. Plan: two-stage drill — non-prod first, then guarded prod canary. Drill tasks: script eviction via admin API, inject delayed KV sync, and simulate node GPU memory pressure. Suggest monthly cadence until stable.

Sam Patel: for the regression suite I propose these labels: 
- reg/prompt/kv-eviction
- reg/prompt/batching-edge-cases
- reg/prompt/streaming-fallthrough
Will store as JSONL cassettes in evaluations repo under tests/postmortem/ so CI can replay.

Maya Chen: action items consolidated (owners + deadlines):
- Sam: build initial prompt regression set and PR to repo (deadline: 2025-11-20)
- Lee: perf-ci job + seq_len toggle (deadline: 2025-11-13)
- Kai: chaos drill runbook + first non-prod drill (deadline: 2025-11-18)
- Jordan: end-to-end validation harness to run the prompt set under load (deadline: 2025-11-25)

Jordan Alvarez: add a nightly gate that runs the prompt suite with the slowest model variant and fails the pipeline if mean latency regresses >5% or tail latency >10% relative to baseline. We should also capture token-level traces for debugging.

Lee Nguyen: CI job snippet for perf-ci I sketched: 
```yaml
jobs:
  run-postmortem-evals:
    runs-on: self-hosted-perf
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: run evals
        run: python infra/evals/run.py --suite=postmortem_kv_eviction --seq_len=2048 --report=artifacts/report.json
```

Kai Ito: I'll add a checklist to the runbook for oncall: pre-checks (traffic slice, alert mute window), rollback plan, and a post-drill quick postmortem template.

Maya Chen: small coordination notes: please tag PRs with `postmortem-eval` so we can track in the retro. We'll review progress in next eng-platform sync. If any owner needs to shift deadlines ping me directly.

incident-bot: scheduled: chaos-drill-nonprod-2025-11-18 created, assigned -> Kai Ito, reminder 48h before. :white_check_mark:

Sam Patel: noted. I'll start extracting sessions tonight and share a seed file in the evals repo.

Lee Nguyen: I'll open the perf-ci PR by EOD tomorrow and link the seq_len toggle RFC.

Jordan Alvarez: I'll prototype the harness that runs prompt sets under concurrent load and submit an alpha for review in 9 days.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone. small ask — keep updates short in this thread (status, blocker). We'll close the action items when PRs landed + first drill complete. :thumbsup:
